title: Enum & EnumItem
summary: Roblox's named-constant system: Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running, Enum.KeyCode.E, Enum.Material.Neon. An Enum is a collection; each entry is an EnumItem with Name and Value.

properties.name: EnumItem.Name / Value / EnumType
properties.description: The item's name, underlying integer, and parent enum.

explanation.whatItIs: Named choices instead of magic numbers: Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce beats remembering 12.
explanation.whyItExists: Roblox APIs take hundreds of fixed-option parameters; enums name them.
whenToUse: Anywhere an API parameter lists options (Material, KeyCode, EasingStyle, PartType…)
whenNotToUse: Your own option sets — plain tables/strings are simpler until you need engine interop
tips: Autocomplete in Studio/VSCode is the enum explorer
commonMistakes: Comparing an EnumItem to its string name: state == "Running" is false
Misspelling and using a wrong sibling item (silently valid code)

examples.title: Enums everywhere
examples.code:
part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball

if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
    print("E!")
end

-- List every material:
for _, item in Enum.Material:GetEnumItems() do
    print(item.Name)
end
